connector.name: Image Generation MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for AI image generation via OpenAI, Stable Diffusion (SD WebUI), or placeholders.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package image-generation-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pvliesdonk account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_READ_ONLY
env.description: When true, write-tagged tools (generate_image) are hidden. Set to false to enable image generation.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SCRATCH_DIR
env.description: Directory for saved generated images. Created automatically on first use.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_DEFAULT_PROVIDER
env.description: Default provider selection: auto (keyword-based), openai, sd_webui, or placeholder. Deprecated alias 'a1111' is also accepted.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key. Enables the OpenAI provider (gpt-image-1, dall-e-3) when set.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_HOST
env.description: SD WebUI base URL (e.g. http://localhost:7860). Enables the SD WebUI provider when set.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_MODEL
env.description: SD WebUI checkpoint name for model-aware preset detection (SD 1.5 vs SDXL vs Lightning vs Flux).

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_A1111_HOST
env.description: Deprecated — use SD_WEBUI_HOST instead. Accepted as fallback.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_A1111_MODEL
env.description: Deprecated — use SD_WEBUI_MODEL instead. Accepted as fallback.

env.name: FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log level for FastMCP internals; app loggers default to INFO, -v overrides both to DEBUG.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SERVER_NAME
env.description: Server name shown to MCP clients in the initialization response.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
env.description: System-level instructions injected into LLM context.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN
env.description: Static bearer token for HTTP authentication.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_AUTH_MODE
env.description: OIDC auth mode: 'remote' (JWKS validation) or 'oidc-proxy' (OAuth proxy). Auto-detected if not set.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_BASE_URL
env.description: Public base URL for OIDC redirects (e.g. https://mcp.example.com). Required for OIDC.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_CONFIG_URL
env.description: OIDC discovery endpoint URL. Required for OIDC.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
env.description: OIDC client ID. Required for OIDC.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: OIDC client secret. Required for OIDC.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_JWT_SIGNING_KEY
env.description: Signing key for OIDC session JWTs (critical on Linux/Docker).

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_AUDIENCE
env.description: Expected JWT audience claim. Leave unset if your provider does not set one.

env.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_REQUIRED_SCOPES
env.description: Comma-separated required OIDC scopes (default: openid for oidc-proxy mode, none for remote mode).

env.description: Verify access token JWT instead of id_token.
